title.narrative: Urgent humanitarian and relief support to the Palestinian people in the Gaza Strip through the air and sea bridge, the first phase

description.narrative: 1430004 will benefit from the assistance provided to them
Providing aid to displaced families affected by the conflict.

Providing relief aid is as follows: Food supplies: (2072) tons of (food baskets - Nadec milk - white beans - chickpeas - cans - beans - tuna - cheese - dates) Non-food shelter materials: (164) tons of (blankets - Sleeping mattresses - winter bags - shelter bags - tents - clothes) Medical materials: (1005) tons of (medical materials) and 16 ambulances, through the air bridge with (25) planes and the sea bridge with (3 ships) with a total weight of aid across The bridges are estimated at (3,241) tons, for affected and displaced families in the Gaza Strip.
